panels.description: Short-term detail from raw events (last 90 days only). Pick a range of a few days or less.

panels.title: Most viewed modules

targets.rawSql:
with cur as (
  select entity_id, sum(views - 0) as views, sum(unique_visitors) as visitor_days
  from analytics.view_daily where entity_type = 1 and day >= $__timeFrom()::date and day <= $__timeTo()::date group by 1),
prev as (
  select entity_id, sum(views - 0) as views
  from analytics.view_daily where entity_type = 1 and day >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))::date and day < $__timeFrom()::date group by 1)
select m.name as module, mf.name as manufacturer, cur.views, cur.visitor_days as "visitor-days",
  case when coalesce(prev.views, 0) = 0 then null else cur.views::numeric / prev.views - 1 end as "vs previous"
from cur left join prev using (entity_id) join public.modules m on m.id = cur.entity_id left join public.manufacturers mf on mf.id = m."manufacturerId"
where cur.views > 0
order by cur.views desc limit 25

panels.description: Module detail views in the range. 'vs previous' compares with the same-length period before it.

panels.title: Most viewed racks

targets.rawSql:
with cur as (
  select entity_id, sum(views - (case when '${owner}' = 'include' then 0 else owner_views end)) as views, sum(unique_visitors) as visitor_days
  from analytics.view_daily where entity_type = 2 and day >= $__timeFrom()::date and day <= $__timeTo()::date group by 1),
prev as (
  select entity_id, sum(views - (case when '${owner}' = 'include' then 0 else owner_views end)) as views
  from analytics.view_daily where entity_type = 2 and day >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))::date and day < $__timeFrom()::date group by 1)
select case when r.public then coalesce(r.name, 'untitled') else 'private rack #' || r.id end as rack, cur.views, cur.visitor_days as "visitor-days",
  case when coalesce(prev.views, 0) = 0 then null else cur.views::numeric / prev.views - 1 end as "vs previous"
from cur left join prev using (entity_id) join public.racks r on r.id = cur.entity_id
where cur.views > 0
order by cur.views desc limit 25

panels.description: Rack views; the owner's own views are excluded unless 'Owner views' is set to include. Private racks show only their id.

panels.title: Most visited pages / sections

targets.rawSql:
with cur as (select route, sum(views) as views, sum(unique_visitors) as visitor_days from analytics.view_daily where entity_type = 9 and day >= $__timeFrom()::date and day <= $__timeTo()::date group by 1),
prev as (select route, sum(views) as views from analytics.view_daily where entity_type = 9 and day >= ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz - ($__timeTo()::timestamptz - $__timeFrom()::timestamptz))::date and day < $__timeFrom()::date group by 1)
select cur.route as page, cur.views, cur.visitor_days as "visitor-days",
  case when coalesce(prev.views, 0) = 0 then null else cur.views::numeric / prev.views - 1 end as "vs previous"
from cur left join prev using (route) order by cur.views desc limit 25

panels.description: Every navigation, grouped by route template (ids are never stored).

panels.title: Trending modules (last 7 days vs the 7 before)

targets.rawSql:
with d as (
  select entity_id,
    sum(views) filter (where day > current_date - 7) as now7,
    sum(views) filter (where day <= current_date - 7 and day > current_date - 14) as prev7
  from analytics.view_daily where entity_type = 1 and day > current_date - 14 group by 1)
select m.name as module, d.now7 as views, coalesce(d.prev7, 0) as "previous 7 d",
  d.now7 - coalesce(d.prev7, 0) as "gain"
from d join public.modules m on m.id = d.entity_id
where d.now7 >= 5 order by 4 desc limit 20

panels.description: Independent of the time picker. Modules with at least 5 views this week, sorted by absolute gain.

panels.title: Look → do: modules

targets.rawSql:
with v as (select entity_id as module_id, sum(views) as views from analytics.view_daily where entity_type = 1 and day >= $__timeFrom()::date and day <= $__timeTo()::date group by 1),
r as (select moduleid as module_id, count(*) as rack_adds from public.rack_modules where $__timeFilter(created) group by 1),
l as (select moduleid as module_id, count(*) as list_adds from public.user_modules where $__timeFilter(updated) group by 1)
select m.name as module, v.views, coalesce(r.rack_adds, 0) as "added to racks", coalesce(l.list_adds, 0) as "list changes",
  round(100.0 * coalesce(r.rack_adds, 0) / v.views, 1) as "rack adds per 100 views"
from v join public.modules m on m.id = v.module_id left join r using (module_id) left join l using (module_id)
order by v.views desc limit 25

panels.description: Do views turn into action? Rack adds and own/want/sell list changes in the same range.

panels.title: Where views come from

targets.rawSql:
select 'search engines' as source, sum(search_views) as views from analytics.view_daily where day >= $__timeFrom()::date and day <= $__timeTo()::date
union all select 'other sites', sum(external_views - search_views) from analytics.view_daily where day >= $__timeFrom()::date and day <= $__timeTo()::date
union all select 'inside Patcher / direct', sum(views - external_views) from analytics.view_daily where day >= $__timeFrom()::date and day <= $__timeTo()::date
